ios.desc:
Bonzii - Virtual Pets

Grow, feed, dress, and collect adorable Bonzii — your cute virtual pets!
A modern take on classic 90s Tamagotchi-style gameplay with addictive mini-games.
Play with your Bonziis everywhere you go. Keep them happy, watch them evolve, and collect all 18 unique creatures!

"This is what fun is about :D 10/10"
"MUCH better than Pou!"
"The mini games are so addicting!"

Key Features:

• Raise & evolve 18 unique Bonziis
• Dress them with clothes & accessories
• Addictive mini-games: Match-3 Nominator + Snake-style Sushi Cowboy
• 25+ unique foods & items
• Game Center achievements + streak rewards
• Smart notifications & Care Mode (play even after evolution!)

Perfect for retro nostalgia lovers and fans of virtual pet simulators.
New 2025/2026 update: Better performance, balanced gameplay, and modern iOS support.
Download now and start collecting your Bonziis today!
